_note: Shared sync file for THE QUIET CAR previs. Written by camera/build_cues.py (DP); do not edit by hand. Times are seconds from the first frame; re-time in build_cues.py when the voice record exists.

set.axes: Blender: Z up; Y down the car from end wall B (0) to end wall A (13, Noor); side A = -X, side B = +X

seats.NOOR: transverse seat against end wall A, under P1, facing down the car
seats.KAI: side B bench under P8, by the doors

BASE.note: asleep: never altered by anything except a cue

BROWN.note: about -2.5 stops; level and colour temperature move together like a failing tungsten load

DIP.note: cue 5 only: near-black with a hint of warmth

OVER.note: cue 8 relight overshoot, settling to BASE in 12 frames

breath.note: a sine on each lit panel's level, layered on top of its keyframes. Depth and period are variables shared with the Composer's hum build, and may drop to 0.02 or slow down after the look-dev visibility check

cues.line: (Noor straightens her lanyard, the badge settling face-out)

cues.note: first groan; from here the windows stay black until 8.10

cues.line: Long day. The Henley account. Again.

cues.ease: sag over 8 frames, level and colour together

cues.line: No, that's — it's the library. They're doing work on the —
cues.note: TRUE BLACK: world, emitters, display all 0; nothing in the render, comp or grade lifts it. Kai is removed in the dark (no animation)
snap to BASE; display back; breathing resumes in phase; windows stay black
Noor is standing in the aisle beside Walter, under P3; 'the panel above her' is P3

cues.line: No. Listen. I'm not leaving the office.
cues.note: P1 steadies and burns brighter: held at 110% (its breathing stops) until 8.10

cues.line: ...They let me go. The whole floor.
— you'd have been kind about it —
(run; Kai's empty seat relights, phone still glowing)

cues.note: the far panel comes on last; every panel exactly BASE; the car is asleep

events.what: doors open at the starting platform; PLATFORM lamp on (cold white) while the train idles
doors close; the starting platform and its lamp slide away (48-58); WINDOWS chase on (glass only, while asleep)
PHONE (Kai): end-call red button on screen
PHONE (Noor): MARK; her screen becomes a key light
DISPLAY: NOW ARRIVING: HOLLOWAY; the Holloway platform slides in, seen only in the door glass (512-520)
doors open; PLATFORM lamp on (cold white ~5000 K, slight green)
PA: 'Thank you for riding quietly.' (no light cue)
platform + lamp slide away in the door glass; WINDOWS stay black
platform gone; PLATFORM 0; the frame is dead still from here
Walter turns the page (no light change)
Kai's phone screen fades to black over 2 s

A.note: the Meter: in the unlit vestibule, standing eye height, level. Holds all 12 panels, Noor, the sign and the display

A2.note: where the creep push lands (1.8 m in from A, tilted ~1 deg up like the push)

B.note: Noor's end, side B corner, low, looking down the car

C.note: side A, just in front of Walter (so his head never crosses frame): Noor singles (aim NOOR) or Bea across the aisle (aim BEA)

W.note: the call (scene 2): low in the aisle by the doors, Noor framed between Walter (left) and Bea (right) with P1 and P2 above her. We watch her the way Walter does

T.note: the test (scene 4): from beside Kai's empty seat, looking back up the car at Noor standing by Walter, with P2, P3 and P4 in frame

C75.note: the confession: near Noor's line of sight down the car, so the panel row reflects in her corneas and reads at 75 mm (dp-notes-02). Her eyeline passes just camera-right of the lens, down the car

D.note: side B, just in front of Bea (so her head never crosses frame): Noor singles or Walter across the aisle

E.note: side A corner at end A: Walter/Bea two-shots, deep staging

W7.note: lie 1 (shot 7): closer and low, so P1's fixture reads large enough to flicker visibly (from W it was a grazing sliver at the far end)

G2.note: the handle (shot 20): Noor at the emergency release, the release itself and the doors in one frame (previs-notes-02)

B2.note: Noor's end, side A corner: looking down the car clear of Bea (from B, Bea's body blocked the foreground)

K.note: at Kai's seat, low beside the phone: the red end-call button with her thumb coming in from above (shot 32). Her face can't share a tight frame with a phone lying on the seat

DP_POV.note: Noor's POV from the doors, looking back up the car at Walter and Bea (shot 61)

S.note: Noor standing beside Walter (TA blocking 188-239 s), seen from in front and slightly down the car (shot 24)

E3.note: shot 61: from down the car on side A, Walter (left) and Bea (right) as Noor walks toward camera on side B to the doors

R.note: shot 31: from beyond Kai's seat, Noor walking down the car toward it

DP_KAI.note: Noor's POV from beside Walter down to Kai's empty seat (shot 25)

E2.note: the Walter/Bea two-shot: from down the car, both in profile facing each other, Noor small between them under the sign. From Noor's end no 32/40 can hold both (they sit 2 m apart, 2.5 m away)

shots.beat: Carriage idling; Noor boards and walks the length of the car; sits under P1 facing us
Noor straightens her lanyard (ceiling out of frame: asleep)
Walter's eyes to the badge and back to his paper
Doors close, train pulls away; 11 MIN
Display: 11 MIN
Phone buzzes, MARK; she glances up at the sign and answers low
'Just leaving the office now.' The ceiling enters: P1 in the top of frame
Walter's eyes lift from his paper to Noor (single)
Bea's eyes open, on Noor (single)
'The Henley account. Again.' P1 and P2 both in frame, Walter and Bea watching her
The whole car reacts: paper lowers, Bea sits up, Kai: 'Was that the brakes?'
'No, don't wait up. Love you.' Hangs up, sags, looks up
Noor's POV: Walter staring at her
Noor's POV: Bea staring at her
Mouths 'Sorry', points over her shoulder at the sign
Kai's phone: MUM. 'Yeah?'
Bea's hand shoots out, too far away
'I'm at the library, Mum.' Brownout
Kai in the brownout: looks up, nervous laugh
'They're doing work on the —' BLACKOUT. Inhale. Lights up: the seat is empty. 'Kai? ... Kai?'
Kai's phone face-up, call connected

handheld.source: a recorded handheld operator clip (real body motion), not procedural noise
handheld.amplitude: about 3-5 cm translation and 1-2 degrees rotation, following Noor's panic
handheld.settle: steady by the cut to shot 21 (Walter's paper); the camera is on sticks again from there

shots.beat: Noor at the doors, the emergency handle. 'Hey. Hey!' (recorded operator motion)
Walter writes in the margin and holds it up
DON'T LIE IN HERE.
Bea writes underneath: IT'S AWAKE NOW. YOU WOKE IT.
Noor reads it twice; eyes to Kai's seat. 'That's insane.'
Kai's empty seat, the phone
Standing beside Walter under P3. 'My name is Noor.' Nothing. 'My name is S—' The wrist clamp. P3 near black, P2/P4 dip. Nobody breathes. Recovery
He releases her. She's shaking
Display: 8 MIN
She sits back down slowly (the walk to P1). Long beat of rails
Kai's phone, still lit: 'Kai?'
She walks down the car to Kai's seat
Her thumb over the red end-call button. She can't
She goes back to her seat; Bea watches the whole time
Bea: 'You okay?'
'I'm f—' (stutter) ... 'I'm not fine.'
'Me neither. I haven't slept in two days.' Nothing happens
'You've seen this before.'
Walter: 'I ride it every night.' ... the wife speech, one unbroken shot
Bea looks at him with real tenderness
Noor turns the badge over in her fingers
Display: 5 MIN
Tick: the far panel out. Bea stiffens. 'Nobody said anything.' Walter's eyes to the lanyard. The camera rides in behind the dark edge
Bea: 'It isn't only what you say.'
The dark comes toward camera; Kai's seat goes dark, his phone glows on in it
She looks down at herself; yanks the lanyard over her head and throws it (each tick takes a step of front light off her face)
The lanyard on the floor: red on grey
It isn't enough
Bea (off): 'Whatever it is, say it.' Noor gathers herself

Noor (off): 'I can't —' / Bea over her: 'Say it.' The 7.9 tick answers the pair. Then 8.5 s of silence (rails, the rising groan, no score event) held on Bea, and on 7.10 her own light dies to the edge
Two panels left; Noor in the last pool; display 2 MIN; her phone buzzes
MARK, in her lap
She looks across at Kai's phone glowing in the dark
Walter, half-lit at the edge of the dark: 'He's asking.' His lit-side eye carries a readable catchlight (P2 or Noor's phone) and the lid line holds
She answers. 'Mark.' ... 'I'm not leaving the office.' (P1 burns brighter)
Walter and Bea come back into the light
'I go to the library —' the half-beat, her eyes to Kai's phone — '— and I come home.'
'I didn't tell you because —' the relights run toward us; Kai's empty seat relights

'I'm sorry.' Silence on the line. The far panel comes on: on the 8.10 frame the tip of the reflected panel row in her corneas completes (P12 itself is sub-pixel at ~10 m; accepted by the Director). Hold C75 as framed, no tighter. The car is asleep
Display: NOW ARRIVING: HOLLOWAY
The train slows; she stands and looks back at them
Walter's smallest nod; Bea has closed her eyes
Out under the cold-white lamp, phone to her ear. Doors close. PA. She slides away in the glass
The opening frame again: Walter turns the page; Kai's phone dims. CUT TO BLACK
